App.demoNotice: Homepage data is illustrative, not your actual exit IP. Automatic detection is not connected yet.
App.demoFooter: Examples preview the interface and are not saved as real lookup history.
App.homeDescription: Your current IPv4 and IPv6 addresses.
App.copyFailed: Copy failed. Select and copy the address manually.
App.queryDescription: Find a public IP’s location and network.
App.placeholder: Enter an IPv4 or IPv6 address
App.emptyQuery: Enter an IP address to view its location and network information.
App.invalidIp: Enter a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address.
App.previewOnly: Live lookup is not enabled yet. Choose an example above.
App.notFoundBody: There is no page at this address.
App.noRecord: No record found for this IP.
App.queryUnavailable: IP information is unavailable. Try again later.
App.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please wait before retrying.
App.historyNotice: Last 10 lookups, saved in this browser only.
App.historyUnavailable: History is available for this visit only.
App.historyClearFailed: Could not clear saved history. It may reappear after a reload.
App.exitAddressKept: You can still copy the address. Retry to load its information.
App.exitNetworkHint: Try again or check your network.
App.exitNotice: Addresses are observed by direct IPv4 / IPv6 HTTPS probes and are not saved to manual query history. Geolocation is approximate. Data:
App.dataUpdatePausedDetail: Exit detection is still available. Try the lookup again later.
App.ipv6Description: Check IPv6 connectivity and current exits.
App.diagnosticSummaryHint: These results describe this attempt, not a permanent classification of your device or network.
App.diagnosticConnectionHint: The exit protocol observed for a request to the main site.
App.diagnosticDirectHint: A direct HTTPS request to the dedicated protocol endpoint.
App.diagnosticConnectionScope: The protocol reported by the trusted site entry may differ from the direct exits.
App.diagnosticDirectScope: Confirms the exit seen by this endpoint; it does not prove native interface support.
App.diagnosticLimitations: An unsuccessful check does not mean the protocol is unsupported. Page and direct connections may use different exits. Times measure web requests, not Ping.
App.routingDescription: Compare the exit IP used for each site.
App.routingConsent: Starting sends your exit IP to the target sites.
App.routingNone: Start to group sites by exit IP.
App.routingMultiple: Multiple exits found within one address family.
App.routingNoMultiple: Observed exits match within each address family.
App.routingGroupHint: IPv4 and IPv6 are compared separately. Filters change the list, not the overall summary. Run again after changing networks.
App.routingFilterHint: The category filters this list; the summary still includes all confirmed results.
App.routingLimitations: These checks use diagnostic endpoints, not full-site or account access. Request times are not Ping.
App.rtcDescription: Compare WebRTC addresses with your web exit IPs.
App.rtcPrivacy: Connects to Cloudflare STUN. No camera or microphone permission needed.
App.rtcHttpsHint: An independent request obtains this protocol’s exit for comparison.
App.rtcFamilyHint: Only the same address family is compared. Different IPv4 and IPv6 addresses are expected.
App.rtcCandidateHint: Collect for up to 8 seconds. Retry independently; partial observations are retained.
App.rtcUnsupported: This browser does not support the check
App.rtcFailed: Browser could not complete the check
App.rtcDifferent: Differs from web {protocol} exit. Check your proxy rules.
App.rtcUnconfirmed: No web {protocol} exit available for comparison.
App.rtcRelay: Relay address; excluded from device-exit comparison.
App.rtcLocal: Local or hidden candidate; excluded from public-exit comparison.
App.rtcNoCandidates: No addresses obtained. Browser or network restrictions may apply.
App.rtcStunErrors: Some connections failed ({count}); results may be incomplete.
App.rtcCapped: Stopped collecting at the address limit.
App.rtcTypes: Local addresses may be hidden behind mDNS names. Mapped addresses are observed by STUN; relay addresses belong to forwarding servers.
App.rtcLimitations: Only public addresses of the same family are compared. Different exits may indicate different routes. Matching exits or no results alone cannot prove that no leak exists. Results stay on this page and are not saved.
App.envDescription: View browser, screen and graphics information.
App.envPrivacy: Read on request. Results stay on this page.
App.envIdle: Start a check to see what this browser reports.
App.envFailed: The check could not finish. Try again.
App.envComparisonHint: Differences may reflect browser settings. They do not establish a proxy or leak.
App.envLimits: These values are reported by the browser and may be hidden or simplified. They cannot confirm the actual device or identity.
App.envGraphicsHint: The Canvas digest is for this check only. Matching reads do not establish a unique device; privacy settings may also limit graphics details.
App.envRequestHint: Request information shows only UA, language and browser hints from page load. Changing the interface language does not change the browser language.
App.dnsDescription: Compare domain records from public resolvers.
App.dnsInvalid: Enter a public domain, without a URL or IP address.
App.dnsPrivacy: The domain is sent to the public resolvers listed below.
App.dnsIdle: Enter a domain and choose a record type to start.
App.dnsHelp: These are server queries to public resolvers, not the DNS used by your device. Caches, routing and resolver policies may cause differences; differences do not establish interference or a leak.
App.dnsTiming: Time measures the server HTTPS request to the resolver, including transport and processing. TTL is the remaining cache lifetime in seconds. Record contents are shown as returned.
App.dnsNoHistory: Queries are not saved in local history. Result links include the domain and record type; share them as needed.
